lines.en: label chinamidate25:
I tap on Chinami’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点下 Chinami 的名字，等她接。

lines.en: : Good morning!
lines.zh: 早上好！

lines.en: And given the fact that she is near constantly glued to her phone, she answers after only half a ring.
lines.zh: 鉴于她几乎时刻黏在手机上，铃声响了半下她就接了。

lines.en: : Good morning, Chinami. You sound...livelier than normal for this time of day.
lines.zh: 早上好，Chinami。你听起来……比这个时间的平常要有精神。

lines.en: : Chinami is excited because her business partner is coming over today! And Chinami heard that you were supposed to come as well!
lines.zh: Chinami 很兴奋，因为她的生意伙伴今天要来！而且 Chinami 听说你也该来！

lines.en: : Was that today?
lines.zh: 是今天吗？

lines.en: : It was!
lines.zh: 就是今天！

lines.en: : Wow, what a convenient coincidence. Is Chika still around?
lines.zh: 哇，真巧。Chika 还在吗？

lines.en: : Big sis Chika is going on a top secret mission. Chinami is unfortunately unable to tell you any more than that since the details are classified.
lines.zh: Chika 姐姐去执行绝密任务了。很遗憾 Chinami 不能多说，因为细节是机密。

lines.en: : No Yumi either?
lines.zh: Yumi 也不在？

lines.en: : Big sis Yumi hasn’t come over in a little while. Chinami is starting to get worried, but she knows she’ll come back one day.
lines.zh: Yumi 姐姐有一阵子没来了。Chinami 开始有点担心，不过她知道她总有一天会回来的。

lines.en: : So-
lines.zh: 那么——

lines.en: : Chinami thinks you should take the hint and just come over already! These questions aren’t helping anybody!
lines.zh: Chinami 觉得你该识趣点，赶紧过来！问这些问题对谁都没帮助！

lines.en: : There’s no need to get impatient. I was just about to head there.
lines.zh: 不用着急。我正准备过去。

lines.en: : Nuh-uh. Chinami felt another question coming. That’s all you adults ever do. Just talk, talk, talk! You never look at the big picture!
lines.zh: 才不是。Chinami 感觉你又要问问题了。你们大人就只会这样。说啊、说啊、说！从来不看大局！

lines.en: : Correct me if I’m wrong, but I’m pretty sure I am the only adult you know.
lines.zh: 要是我说错了你纠正我，不过我敢说我是你认识的唯一一个大人。

lines.en: : This is exactly what Chinami is talking about! You just don’t know when to stop talking!
lines.zh: Chinami 说的就是这个！你根本不知道什么时候该闭嘴！

lines.en: : Okay. I’m hanging up now.
lines.zh: 好。我挂了。

lines.en: : Wait! Can you bring doughnuts? You can’t have a business meeting without doughnuts and Chinami might die if she gets them on her own.
lines.zh: 等等！你能带甜甜圈来吗？商务会议没有甜甜圈怎么行，而且 Chinami 自己去买的话可能会死。

lines.en: : Nope. But I’ll see you soon.
lines.zh: 不行。不过马上见。

lines.en: : So rude!
lines.zh: 太没礼貌了！

lines.en: I hang up the phone and begin my journey over to Chika’s place.
lines.zh: 我挂断电话，动身前往 Chika 家。

lines.en: scene black
Why she’d ask {i}me{/i} to bring over food when I am both not her intern and significantly poorer than the other people she has coming over, I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我既不是她的实习生，又比今天要来的其他人穷得多，她为什么偏偏叫{i}我{/i}带吃的，我实在不明白。

lines.en: But expecting rational decisions out of isolated girls who spend the majority of their day slaughtering cartoons is probably not a thing I should be doing in the first place.
lines.zh: 不过，指望那些整天关在家里、大部分时间都在屠杀卡通人物的女孩做出理性的决定，本来就不该是我该做的事。

lines.en: Either way, I board a bus to the old district instead of pushing my luck and trying to have Touka and whichever one of her drivers she chose today pick me up along the way.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我没去碰运气让 Touka 和她今天挑的那个司机顺路接我，而是上了开往老城区的一辆公交车。

lines.en: scene chinamiplayshouse1
Which, of course, means that I show up later than the other two as public transportation is only reliable around 50%% of the time.
lines.zh: 当然，结果就是我比另外两位到得晚——毕竟公共交通只有大概 50%% 的时候靠得住。

lines.en: But on the bright side, Touka is wearing what has quickly become my favorite outfit of hers. And one that will make “babysitting” exponentially harder to do as my focus lies elsewhere.
lines.zh: 不过好消息是，Touka 穿的那身已经迅速成为她所有衣服里我最喜欢的一套。而这套衣服会让「看孩子」的难度成倍上升，因为我的注意力全跑别处去了。

lines.en: : Chinami! What’s that thing?!
lines.zh: Chinami！那是什么东西？！

lines.en: : Chinami believes that is called a “stove!” It’s where big sis Chika cooks Chinami’s eggs.
lines.zh: Chinami 认为那叫「炉子」！Chika 姐姐就是在那儿给 Chinami 煎蛋的。

lines.en: : Your sister cooks for you? Is that even allowed?
lines.zh: 你姐姐给你做饭？这也能行？

lines.en: : Big sis Chika is the {i}only{/i} person who cooks for Chinami. Big sis Yumi has tried, but she isn’t very good.
lines.zh: Chika 姐姐是{i}唯一{/i}给 Chinami 做饭的人。Yumi 姐姐试过，不过她手艺不怎么样。

lines.en: scene chinamiplayshouse2
: How come you never cook for me? Shouldn’t you try acting a little more like Chinami’s sister?
lines.zh: 你怎么从来不给我做饭？你不该试着更像 Chinami 的姐姐一点吗？

lines.en: : Can I start by covering your mouth so you can’t speak anymore?
lines.zh: 能不能先把你的嘴堵上、让你再也说不出话？

lines.en: : You’re lucky you’re my sister or I’d have you fired.
lines.zh: 算你是我妹妹，不然我早把你开了。

lines.en: : You should really come up with a different solution for all of your problems than just firing people.
lines.zh: 你真该为所有问题想个别的解决办法，别老是炒人鱿鱼。

lines.en: scene chinamiplayshouse3
: Papa!
lines.zh: 爸爸！

lines.en: : Jeeves!
lines.zh: Jeeves！

lines.en: : Oh, Sensei. You’re so late that I assumed you just forgot about our plans.
lines.zh: 哦，Sensei。你来得这么晚，我还以为你把我们的计划忘了呢。

lines.en: : Me? Forget? No way.
lines.zh: 我？忘？不可能。

lines.en: : Chinami had no idea Papa’s real name was Jeeves! He looks like more of a Philip to her.
lines.zh: Chinami 完全不知道爸爸的真名是 Jeeves！她觉得他看起来更像叫 Philip。

lines.en: : Philip Jeeves Tsukioka the Fourteenth!
lines.zh: Philip Jeeves Tsukioka 十四世！

lines.en: : Wasn’t it thirteen last time?
lines.zh: 上一次不是十三世吗？

lines.en: : I had to let another one go. Good butlers are just impossible to come by nowadays.
lines.zh: 我又辞退了一个。这年头好管家真是可遇不可求。

lines.en: scene chinamiplayshouse4
: Chinami doesn’t see any doughnuts. Who do you think you are, showing up so unprepared?
lines.zh: Chinami 没看到任何甜甜圈。你以为你是谁啊，来这么没准备？

lines.en: : Chinami even had to give a tour of her whole house all by herself! Do you have any idea how much work that was for her?!
lines.zh: Chinami 还得一个人带人参观整栋房子！你知道那对她来说是多大的工作量吗？！

lines.en: : If you stood in the doorway behind you, you probably wouldn’t have even had to move.
lines.zh: 你要是就站在身后那个门口，大概连动都不用动。

lines.en: : This is why Chinami needed you here. CEOs are not trained for small jobs like that. Chinami has far better things to do.
lines.zh: 所以 Chinami 才需要你在这儿。CEO 可没受过做这种小事的训练。Chinami 有更重要的事要做。

lines.en: : Chinami! Can we eat more cereal? It may be the last time I ever see it, so I want to cherish the experience!
lines.zh: Chinami！我们还能再吃点麦片吗？这可能我这辈子最后一次见到它了，所以我想好好珍惜这个体验！

lines.en: scene chinamiplayshouse5
: Big sis Chika says only one bowl a day! Otherwise, Chinami will get fat and no man will ever love her!
lines.zh: Chika 姐姐说一天只能吃一碗！不然 Chinami 会变胖，就永远没有男人爱她了！

lines.en: : Can we play with your toys, then?
lines.zh: 那我们能玩你的玩具吗？

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t have any toys. But she will show you the super cool phone her Papa bought for her. It’s her most prized possession.
lines.zh: Chinami 没有玩具。不过她可以给你看她爸爸给她买的超酷手机。那是她最珍视的宝贝。

lines.en: scene chinamiplayshouse6
Chinami and Tsukasa scurry off to the bedroom, leaving Touka and me alone in the other half of the apartment.
lines.zh: Chinami 和 Tsukasa 小跑进了卧室，把公寓的另一半留给 Touka 和我独处。

lines.en: : Thank you...truly. This is not something I would have been able to do on my own.
lines.zh: 谢谢你……真的。这件事我一个人是做不来的。

lines.en: : Not good with kids either?
lines.zh: 也不擅长应付小孩？

lines.en: : It’s less that and more...umm...how should I put this-
lines.zh: 与其说是那个，不如说是……嗯……该怎么说呢——

lines.en: : The apartment?
lines.zh: 这间公寓？

lines.en: : It is an utter crime that people are allowed to live in such places.
lines.zh: 居然有人被允许住在这样的地方，这本身就是彻头彻尾的犯罪。

lines.en: scene black
Touka follows the other two girls into the living room, prompting me to do the same as I don’t want to be the one to clean up the spilled milk and cereal all over the kitchen table.
lines.zh: Touka 跟着另外两个女孩进了客厅，我也只好跟上，因为我可不想最后去收拾餐桌上洒得到处都是的牛奶和麦片。

lines.en: Granted, I probably {i}will{/i} be the person to do just that before the day ends as I’m not sure if Touka and Tsukasa even understand the concept of cleaning on their own instead of having a maid do it for them.
lines.zh: 话是这么说，今天结束之前{i}大概还是会{/i}由我来收拾，因为我不确定 Touka 和 Tsukasa 是否明白「自己打扫」而不是让女仆代劳这个概念。

lines.en: scene chinamiplayshouse7
I guess I could always just make Chinami do it, though. It’s about time she learned some responsibility rather than just manipulating me into doing her dirty work.
lines.zh: 不过我想我也可以让 Chinami 去做。她也该学点责任感了，别老是操纵我替她干脏活。

lines.en: : What even is this strange piece of furniture? A...sculpture? I’ve never seen anything like it before.
lines.zh: 这件奇怪的家具到底是什么？一座……雕塑？我从没见过这种东西。

lines.en: : Me neither, but it’s been here since I started coming and I just haven’t had it in me to question it.
lines.zh: 我也没见过，不过从我开始来的时候就在这儿了，我也懒得去问。

lines.en: : That’s the TV antenna from the room below us! Nobody lives there anymore, but Chinami heard the whole place will fall apart if we try to remove it!
lines.zh: 那是楼下那间房的电视天线！已经没人住了，不过 Chinami 听说要是把它拆了，整栋房子都会塌！

lines.en: : So please be careful! Chinami doesn’t want to be homeless!
lines.zh: 所以请小心点！Chinami 可不想无家可归！

lines.en: scene chinamiplayshouse8
: I don’t think I can do this, Sensei. This place is as good as a death trap. I’m not even sure if I’ll be able to sleep knowing this poor girl will be spending the night here.
lines.zh: 我觉得我撑不下去，Sensei。这地方简直就是个死亡陷阱。一想到这个可怜的女孩要在这儿过夜，我都不知道自己还睡不睡得着。

lines.en: : Oh. And to clarify, I meant poor in regard to the amount of pity I feel for her. That was not me suggesting how much better off I am.
lines.zh: 哦。澄清一下，我说「可怜」是指我对她的同情程度。我并不是在暗示我自己过得多好。

lines.en: : Though...saying that out loud may have just had the opposite effect.
lines.zh: 不过……这话一说出口，效果大概刚好相反。

lines.en: : What I’m trying to say is-
lines.zh: 我想说的是——

lines.en: : I get it, Touka. The apartment sucks. But it’s all the Chosokabes can afford, unfortunately.
lines.zh: 我懂，Touka。这公寓是很糟。可不幸的是，Chosokabe 一家只负担得起这个。

lines.en: : Hey, Chinami. What’s that over there?
lines.zh: 嘿，Chinami。那边那个是什么？

lines.en: : That’s called a “television!” Big sis Yumi found it on the street and sometimes the picture even stays clear for ten whole minutes!
lines.zh: 那叫「电视」！Yumi 姐姐在街上捡回来的，有时候画面甚至能连续清晰整整十分钟！

lines.en: : Not that. The thing next to it.
lines.zh: 不是那个。是它旁边那个。

lines.en: : Oh! Chinami will show you!
lines.zh: 哦！Chinami 拿给你看！

lines.en: scene black
Chinami runs over to the same table she ran to the first time I ever came here...
lines.zh: Chinami 跑向那张桌子——就是我第一次来这儿时她跑过去的那张……

lines.en: And lifts up the same photo frame she showed me before thinking about castles became a near daily occurrence.
lines.zh: 然后拿起同一个相框——在「城堡」变成几乎每天都要想的事之前，她给我看过的那个。

lines.en: scene chinamiplayshouse9
: This is Chinami’s mom! Isn’t she pretty?
lines.zh: 这是 Chinami 的妈妈！她很漂亮吧？

lines.en: : Chinami wants to look like her when she gets older. But she thinks big sis Chika will probably look more like her than Chinami will.
lines.zh: Chinami 想长大了像她。不过她觉得 Chika 姐姐大概会比她更像妈妈。

lines.en: : Do you look more like your dad or something?
lines.zh: 那你是不是更像你爸爸？

lines.en: scene chinamiplayshouse10
: Chinami doesn’t really know what her dad looks like. But maybe!
lines.zh: Chinami 其实不知道爸爸长什么样。不过也许是吧！

lines.en: : If Chinami didn’t have this picture of her mom, she probably wouldn’t know what she looked like either. She’s been gone for a long time.
lines.zh: 要是没有妈妈这张照片，Chinami 大概也不会知道她长什么样。她已经走了很久了。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: 这样啊。

lines.en: : So you don’t really know what it’s like to have parents at all, huh?
lines.zh: 所以你其实根本不知道有父母是什么感觉，是吧？

lines.en: : Tsukasa, don’t ask questions like that! It’s extremely insensitive.
lines.zh: Tsukasa，别问这种问题！这非常不体贴。

lines.en: scene chinamiplayshouse11
: Chinami doesn’t mind! Her mom still watches over her while big sis Chika and her teacher give her all the love she needs to survive.
lines.zh: Chinami 不介意！妈妈还在天上看着她，而 Chika 姐姐和老师给了她活下去所需要的全部爱。

lines.en: : She does wish she was still alive, though. And she wishes her dad was still here too, but big sis Chika gets angry whenever Chinami says that, so she doesn’t say it much.
lines.zh: 不过她确实希望妈妈还活着。也希望爸爸还在。可每次 Chinami 这么说，Chika 姐姐都会生气，所以她不太说了。

lines.en: scene chinamiplayshouse12
: I am beginning to believe that everything about today has been carefully designed to reduce me to tears. It is a miracle I haven’t cried yet.
lines.zh: 我开始相信，今天的一切都是精心设计来把我弄哭的。我到现在还没哭，简直是个奇迹。

lines.en: : It’s no wonder you chose Chika over me during the first annual Super Mega Ultimate Dorm Wars. No high end restaurant nor plate of foie gras could compete with this...
lines.zh: 难怪在第一届超级无敌终极宿舍大战里你选了 Chika 而不是我。再高级的餐厅、再好的一盘鹅肝也比不过这个……

lines.en: : This...heart wrenching, unreserved look into the lives of those less fortunate than me. Or even {i}you,{/i} for that matter.
lines.zh: 这种……令人心碎、毫无保留地窥见那些比我、甚至比{i}你{/i}更不幸的人的生活。

lines.en: : How do things get to this point for some people while so many others live life completely unaware of the dire straits our fellow man can wind up in for no good reason at all?
lines.zh: 为什么有些人会走到这一步，而那么多其他人却完全不知道自己的同类会在毫无理由的情况下陷入怎样的绝境？

lines.en: : Can I say something about living inside a bubble without you making some sort of allusion to the Tsukioka bubble wrap empire?
lines.zh: 我能不能说一句「活在泡泡里」，而你不顺便扯到 Tsukioka 家的气泡膜帝国？

lines.en: scene chinamiplayshouse13
: Not anymore, you can’t. Now, that’s going to be the only thing I can think of.
lines.zh: 不能了。现在这只会是我唯一能想到的东西。

lines.en: : Onee-chan! Jeeves! Play with us!
lines.zh: Onee-chan！Jeeves！来陪我们玩！

lines.en: scene chinamiplayshouse14
: Play with you how? There’s hardly any room to do anything here and Chika advised that we must not take Chinami outside.
lines.zh: 怎么陪你们玩？这儿几乎没地方可动，而且 Chika 叮嘱过绝对不能把 Chinami 带出门。

lines.en: : Let’s play house so Chinami can know what it’s like to have a family!
lines.zh: 我们来玩过家家吧，这样 Chinami 就能知道有家人是什么感觉！

lines.en: : Tsukasa! Please don’t say such insensitive things!
lines.zh: Tsukasa！请不要说这么不体贴的话！

lines.en: : It’s okay! Chinami wants to play too! She thinks it sounds fun and has never played a game with this many people before!
lines.zh: 没关系！Chinami 也想玩！她觉得听起来很好玩，而且从来没玩过这么多人一起的游戏！

lines.en: : She is afraid she will mess up, though! So please tell her if she’s doing anything wrong!
lines.zh: 不过她怕自己会搞砸！所以如果她做错了什么，请告诉她！

lines.en: : H...How exactly does one play “house?”
lines.zh: 那……「过家家」到底怎么玩？

lines.en: : We have two girls with a skewed perception of standard family dynamics, one girl with virtually {i}no{/i} perception of that, and me. There is no way this is going to end well.
lines.zh: 我们有两位对正常家庭关系认知扭曲的女孩、一位几乎{i}毫无{/i}这方面认知的女孩，还有我。这事不可能有好下场。

lines.en: : It’ll be fine! Chinami and I will be sisters and you two can be the parents!
lines.zh: 没问题的！Chinami 和我当姐妹，你们俩当父母！

lines.en: scene chinamiplayshouse15
: P-Parents?! Us?!
lines.zh: 父、父母？！我们？！

lines.en: : Where else did you think this was going?
lines.zh: 不然你以为会往哪边发展？

lines.en: : I had {i}assumed{/i} that I was going to be your daughter as well. I have no idea how this game works.
lines.zh: 我{i}本以为{/i}我也是要当你女儿的。我完全不知道这游戏怎么玩。

lines.en: : You can call me “daddy” if you want. I don’t mind.
lines.zh: 你想的话可以叫我「爸爸」。我不介意。

lines.en: scene chinamiplayshouse16
: Of course {i}you{/i} don’t mind. But that’s absolutely not something I want to be calling you in front of my little sister.
lines.zh: {i}你{/i}当然不介意。可我绝对不想在我妹妹面前这么叫你。

lines.en: : So what I’m hearing is it would be okay if we {i}weren’t{/i} in front of your little sister.
lines.zh: 那我听到的就是：只要{i}不{/i}在你妹妹面前就行。

lines.en: : That is what you are hearing because that is what you {i}want{/i} to hear. The reality is-
lines.zh: 你听到的正是你想{i}听{/i}的。而现实是——

lines.en: : Chinami says stop flirting and play already!
lines.zh: Chinami 说别打情骂俏了，快点玩！

lines.en: : I think we’re already playing. Those two seem to have gotten in character rather quickly. Wouldn’t you agree, Chinami?
lines.zh: 我觉得我们已经玩起来了。那两位似乎入戏挺快的。你说呢，Chinami？

lines.en: : Oh! Chinami has no clue. She’s never seen real parents talk to each other before.
lines.zh: 哦！Chinami 完全不知道。她从没见过真正的父母互相说话。

lines.en: : What am I supposed to call you?
lines.zh: 我该叫你什么？

lines.en: : “Touka” would be a good place to start, but even that seems to prove challenging for you the vast majority of the time.
lines.zh: 从「Touka」开始就挺好的，不过大多数时候连这个对你来说都挺难的。

lines.en: : How about “darling?” Does that work?
lines.zh: 那叫「亲爱的」怎么样？行吗？

lines.en: : I suppose, so long as it never leaves this room.
lines.zh: 可以吧，只要这话别走出这个房间。

lines.en: : Jeeves! Uhh...I mean...Papa! We want attention! Give us attention!
lines.zh: Jeeves！呃……我是说……爸爸！我们要关注！快关注我们！

lines.en: : Chinami wants to eat peanuts!
lines.zh: Chinami 想吃花生！

lines.en: scene black
: I don’t care how badly Chinami wants to eat peanuts when peanuts will kill her.
lines.zh: 花生会要了 Chinami 的命，我才不管她有多想吃。

lines.en: : Mother! Chinami is having suicidal thoughts and must be talked back from the brink of death!
lines.zh: 母亲！Chinami 正在产生自杀念头，必须把她从死亡边缘劝回来！

lines.en: : Why did we immediately jump to the hardest possible part of parenting?! I’ve only been a mother for thirty seconds! I’m not prepared for this!
lines.zh: 我们怎么一下就跳到当父母最难的部分了？！我才当了三十秒的妈妈！我没准备好！

lines.en: scene chinamiplayshouse17
The four of us take a seat on the bed (You know, the way real families always do) and just...start staring at one another.
lines.zh: 我们四个在床上坐下（你知道的，就像真正的家庭那样），然后就……开始大眼瞪小眼。

lines.en: In other news, this game sucks.
lines.zh: 另外说一句，这游戏真烂。

lines.en: scene chinamiplayshouse18
But at least it gives me another opportunity to gaze down at what is at least temporarily and fictionally mine.
lines.zh: 不过至少这又给了我一个机会，可以低头盯着那至少暂时、在虚构中属于我的东西。

lines.en: : Mother. Mother. Father is staring at your chest.
lines.zh: 母亲。母亲。父亲在盯着你的胸看。

lines.en: : He does that, dear. It’s not something that can be helped.
lines.zh: 他一直都这样，亲爱的。这是没办法的事。

lines.en: : Mommy, can I ask you a question?
lines.zh: 妈妈，我能问你个问题吗？

lines.en: : Of course, Chinami. What is it?
lines.zh: 当然可以，Chinami。什么问题？

lines.en: : How come Chinami doesn’t look like either one of her parents?
lines.zh: 为什么 Chinami 长得既不像爸爸也不像妈妈？

lines.en: scene chinamiplayshouse19
: Father?
lines.zh: 父亲？

lines.en: : There can only be one explanation.
lines.zh: 只可能有一个解释。

lines.en: : Your mother is having an affair.
lines.zh: 你们的母亲有外遇。

lines.en: scene chinamiplayshouse20
: What?!
lines.zh: 什么？！

lines.en: : Mommy, why?!
lines.zh: 妈妈，为什么？！

lines.en: : Is it with the gardener?! I’ve seen the way you’ve been looking at him!
lines.zh: 是跟园丁吗？！我都看见你看他的眼神了！

lines.en: : You’re already turning the whole family against me?! It hasn’t even been five minutes!
lines.zh: 你这么快就挑拨全家人来反对我了？！连五分钟都还没到！

lines.en: : You did this to yourself, darling. All I ever did was love you.
lines.zh: 这是你自找的，亲爱的。我所做的一切不过就是爱你。

lines.en: scene chinamiplayshouse21
: Tsukasa, what is an affair? Chinami was just playing along, but she doesn’t really know what that word means.
lines.zh: Tsukasa，外遇是什么？Chinami 刚才只是顺着演，其实她不懂那个词是什么意思。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure it’s when a mom or dad starts spending time with somebody else’s mom or dad. Which might explain why you don’t look like them, Chinami.
lines.zh: 我猜就是妈妈或爸爸开始跟别人家的妈妈或爸爸混在一起。这大概能解释为什么你长得不像他们，Chinami。

lines.en: : What we need to do now is find your real dad! And we can start by making a list of all of the men Mother is seeing behind Father’s back!
lines.zh: 我们现在要做的就是找到你的亲生爸爸！我们可以先列一张清单，把母亲背着父亲交往的所有男人都写下来！

lines.en: : Just how many others are there, Touka? Tell me.
lines.zh: 到底还有多少个，Touka？告诉我。

lines.en: : Hah...
: I really hope Chika’s day is going better than mine so far...
lines.zh: 我真希望 Chika 今天过得比我顺利……

lines.en: scene black
{i}Meanwhile, Chika’s day...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时，Chika 的一天……{/i}
